ja: －－－　「ＲＧ 1/144 νガンダム」（別売り）連動アイテムが登場！　－－－
※この商品にＭＳ本体は含まれません。
別売りの「ＲＧ 1/144 νガンダム」（店頭販売アイテム）にジョイントして、
νガンダムのＨＷＳ(ヘビー・ウェポン・システム)が再現できる拡張セットが登場。
●　「ＲＧ νガンダムＨＷＳ」を再現する機体各部の重装甲アーマー＆武装類を同梱！
※ハイ・メガ・シールドは、通常のシールドに拡張パーツを装着する仕様です。通常のシールドは、本体商品側に付属するものを使用します。
●　店頭販売のＭＳ本体に準拠した成形色で再現！
●　新規デザインのリアリスティックデカールが付属
※デカールデザインは「ＲＧ 1/144 νガンダムＨＷＳ」と同じものです。
セット内容　：　胸部装甲ユニット ／ フロントアーマー装甲ユニット ／ 脚部スラスターユニット ／ ハイパー・メガ・ライフル ／ ハイ・メガ・シールド拡張パーツ／ リアリスティックデカール

en: --- "RG 1/144 νGundam" (sold separately) linked items are now available! ---
*This product does not include the MS body.
Jointed with the separately sold "RG 1/144 νGundam" (in-store sales item),
Introducing an expansion set that allows you to reproduce νGundam's HWS (Heavy Weapon System).
● Includes heavy armor and weapons for each part of the aircraft that reproduces "RG νGundamHWS"!
*High Mega Seal is a standard Seal with extended parts attached. For normal Seal, use the one that comes with the main product.
● Reproduced with molding colors that conform to the MS body sold in stores!
● Comes with a newly designed realistic decal.
*Decal design is the same as "RG 1/144 νGundamHWS".
Set contents: Chest armor unit / Front armor unit / Leg thruster unit / Hyper Mega Rifle / High Mega Seal expansion parts / Realistic decal
This product is jointed with "RG 1/144 νGundam" (separately sold in-store item),
An 'expansion' set to reproduce the νGundam equipped with HWS (Heavy Weapon System).
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the photos on this page, you will need the main product "RG 1/144 νGundam" (separately sold in-store item) and this product.
* High Mega Seal is a standard Seal with extended parts attached. For normal Seal, use the one that comes with the main product.
* The additional armor is heavy, so please refer to the poses in the photo and display it in a stable location.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo has been partially painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.
*Product materials may change depending on the production period of the sold product. Thank you for your understanding.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company, other projects, or overseas.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to production availability, we are limiting the quantity of this product that can be purchased per person. note that.
- Shipping of this product may change depending on the application status and production circumstances. Thank you for your understanding.
・Product images are under development and may differ from the actual product.
- Product specifications are scheduled as of 20206. Please note that there may be changes.
